title: Messianic Prophecy
summary: Messianic Prophecy gathers prophetic texts about a coming Davidic deliverer.
historical_context: Messianic hope develops from the Davidic covenant and the prophetic search for a righteous king who will heal exile and injustice.
ancient_near_east_context: Prophetic literature addresses imperial pressure, covenant breach, temple life, and national collapse within the ancient Near East.
literary_context: Prophetic speech uses poetry, oracle forms, sign actions, and symbolic imagery to confront and comfort the covenant people.
covenantal_significance: Messianic Prophecy shows how judgment, mercy, and hope serve the covenant storyline.
interpretive_notes: Read the oracle first in its own historical setting.
Prophetic speech is covenantal proclamation before it is prediction.
common_questions: How does Messianic Prophecy fit the biblical storyline?
What should readers avoid when interpreting Messianic Prophecy?
